outcome: Receipt of postpartum care (PPC) visit within 60 days of delivery
cohort: 617,010 women with a delivery between March 25, 2014, and November 1, 2019, who were continuously enrolled in Texas Medicaid during the study period (84 days pre-delivery to 60 days post-delivery)
finding: Diabetes, hypertension, and mental health conditions were prevalent among Texas Medicaid pregnant enrollees and were predictive of receiving a postpartum care visit.
